steps.subject: sky
steps.action: blend blue into the top of the sky
steps.load: dabbed bristles into paint for even color

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: paint big dark evergreen trees
steps.load: loaded full on both sides
steps.motion: center line run down, more pressure lower
steps.where: across the canvas in front of the background trees
steps.rule: more pressure lower down makes the tree fuller and stronger

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: add light trunks through the evergreens
steps.load: marbled mix rolled onto knife edge
steps.motion: cut through with the knife edge
steps.rule: a few pulls suggest many trees where few are painted

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: add yellow-green highlights on the evergreens
steps.load: yellow mixed into the dark, then dulled
steps.motion: light touches on the lit side
steps.rule: light from the right is easiest for a right-handed painter

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: tap grassy patches along the bank
steps.load: tapped mixed colors on the brush
steps.where: grassy bank below the evergreens near the river

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: tap liquid white highlights on the grass
steps.load: touch of liquid white added to the brush
steps.motion: tap on top of the grassy patches
steps.rule: thins and brightens the paint so it stands out as a highlight

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: dab bush shapes below the evergreens
steps.load: carried over from the grass mix

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: add a red-tinted bush beside the first one
steps.load: touch of red added to the same mix

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: paint small sticks and twigs in the bushes
steps.load: thin brown and white on the liner
steps.motion: indicate little sticks with fine strokes
steps.where: in the bushes near the trees

steps.subject: water
steps.action: pull pure white straight down to make water
steps.load: pure white loaded on a clean brush
steps.motion: pull straight down through the colors
steps.rule: pulling white down mixes into colors below to make water

steps.subject: land
steps.action: paint a small bank near the water
steps.load: mixed and rolled onto knife edge
steps.motion: lay down a small bank shape

steps.subject: water
steps.action: barely graze shimmer lines in the water
steps.load: liquid white thins the titanium white
steps.motion: barely graze the canvas with the fan
steps.where: in the water below the bank

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: make stones with a filbert pull
steps.load: thin mix, dark on one side and light on the other
steps.rule: one stroke gives both highlight and shadow

steps.subject: water line
steps.action: clean up stone bases and add a small ripple
steps.load: cleaned with fan brush
steps.motion: clean base of each stone and ripple

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: dark background bush shapes
steps.load: dark mix on a 1in brush
steps.where: background spot where the bush lives

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: paint a multicolor bush with yellows and green
steps.load: thinned with liquid white then yellows and green

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: push upward to form a bush shape
steps.load: red added to the yellow ochre

steps.subject: land
steps.action: lay a base color for the land
steps.load: mixed on the brush

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: pull white straight down under the bank
steps.load: brush with a little white
steps.motion: pull straight down then gently across
steps.where: right under the bank and bushes
steps.rule: gentle pass across gives a watery feel

steps.subject: other: thin white glaze
steps.action: lay thin white over the thick paint
steps.load: liquid white mixed in to thin the white
steps.rule: thin paint slides over thick without mushing together

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: more stones with the filbert
steps.load: reloaded with the stone mix

steps.subject: land
steps.action: highlight along the bank edge
steps.load: brown and white on the filbert

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: pop in little bushes down the side with green
steps.load: a little green and yellow on the fan
steps.motion: work little things down the side
steps.where: down the side near the bank
steps.rule: breaks up a straight line along the edge

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: scrape dark sticks and twigs with the knife
steps.load: dark mix on the knife

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: add a few white sticks with the knife
steps.load: white on the knife
steps.motion: pop in a few white sticks

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: paint a big tree trunk with both browns
steps.load: both browns, light and dark, loaded at once
steps.motion: pull down so both sides mark at once

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: tap the big tree trunk
steps.load: same loaded fan brush
steps.where: the big tree that fell over

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: paint thin limbs and twigs
steps.load: brown thinned with paint thinner
steps.where: a few spots in the back

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: add a few dark leaves on the tree
steps.load: dark mix on the fan
steps.where: on the tree in the back

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: add a few light sparkles on the tree
steps.load: same fan brush

rules: [06:32] leaving gaps in a tree looks more realistic
[07:03] trees left showing through add depth to the forest
[09:54] background tree gets no highlight since large trees take the light
[10:23] dark areas matter more than highlights, so keep them
